article_manifest.title: Mali: "At one point, I stopped counting deaths," says El Bachir Thiam, a former State Security detainee
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: «À un moment, j’ai arrêté de compter les décès», témoigne El Bachir Thiam, ancien détenu de la Sécurité d’État
article_manifest.summary: In Mali, it has been a little over a year since El Bachir Thiam was released from the jails of the State Security of Mali.

article_manifest.title: Bandits burn 12 family members
article_manifest.original_title: Bandits burn 12 family members
article_manifest.summary: Twelve members of the same family have been killed after armed bandits set their residence ablaze during an attack on Gidan Taba village in Maradun Local Government Area of Zamfara State. Seven other residents were also abducted during the attack, which occurred on Saturday night in Dosara Birnin Kaya Ward, despite efforts by the community to alert security agencies.

article_manifest.title: EXPULSION OF BURKINABE orphans from Guinea: Lessons to be learned
article_manifest.original_title: EXPULSION D’ORPAILLEURS BURKINABE DE GUINEE : Les leçons à tirer
article_manifest.summary: EXPULSION OF BURKINABE gold miners from Guinea: Lessons to be learned On November 2, the Guinean authorities decided to put an end to illegal gold mining in their country, especially in the Northeast of the country. According to them, this practice poses a threat not only to the environment, but also to human and animal health . In Siguiri, for example, they say, many people have been hospitalized because of the use of cyanide.

article_manifest.title: MALIAN ARMED FORCES: The Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces completes his tour of authority visits to the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA)
article_manifest.original_title: FORCES ARMÉES MALIENNES : Le Chef d’État-Major Général des Armées achève sa tournée de visites d’autorité à la Direction de l’Information et des Relations Publiques des Armées (DIRPA)
article_manifest.summary: The Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces (CEMGA), Major General Elisée Jean DAO, completed, on Thursday, November 5, 2026, his tour of authority in the headquarters and service directorates of the Malian Armed Forces by a step at the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA) This visit was marked by the visit of the facilities, the presentation of the latest acquisitions in equipment of the Management as well as a live intervention of the CEMGA on the antennas of the radio FAMa FM and the Web TV (FAMa TV).

article_manifest.title: Menaka and Kidal: Several terrorist groups neutralized by the FAMa
article_manifest.original_title: Ménaka et Kidal : Plusieurs regroupements terroristes neutralisés par les FAMa
article_manifest.summary: In its statement issued this Sunday, the General Staff of the Armed Forces indicates that on Friday, November 6, 2026, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible to locate, about fifty kilometers southwest of the city of Menaka, a group of terrorists with war materials. He specifies that after confirming the target, the position was hit successfully In addition, the military hierarchy reports that on Saturday, November 7, 2026, another group of terrorists, also equipped with war materials, was identified about ninety kilometers south of the city of Kidal.

article_manifest.title: Arlit: civil society calls on the European Union and puts on the table the consequences of more than 50 years of uranium exploitation by Orano
article_manifest.original_title: Arlit : la société civile interpelle l’Union européenne et remet sur la table les conséquences de plus de 50 ans d’exploitation de l’uranium par Orano
article_manifest.summary: The Arlit Civil Society Coordination reacted strongly, this Sunday, November 8, 2026, to the statements attributed to the European Union concerning military cooperation between Niger and Algeria. In a statement with a particularly firm tone, the organization denounces what it considers to be interference in the affairs of two sovereign states .

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa strike several terrorist positions in Menaka and Kidal
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : les FAMa frappent plusieurs positions terroristes à Ménaka et Kidal
article_manifest.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) carried out several strikes against positions of terrorist armed groups in the regions of Menaka and Kidal, on 6 and 7 November 2026, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko According to the General Staff of the Armed Forces, a first group of terrorists with war material was located on Friday, November 6, about 50 km southwest of Menaka.

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa neutralize several terrorist groups in Menaka and Kidal
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : les FAMa neutralisent plusieurs regroupements terroristes à Ménaka et Kidal
article_manifest.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing the permanent operations of surveillance, control and security of the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko . On Friday, November 6, 2026, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible to locate, about fifty (50) kilometers southwest of the city of Menaka, a group of terrorists with war materials.

article_manifest.title: DSSA: Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces on an official visit
article_manifest.original_title: DSSA : le Chef d’État-major Général des Armées en visite d’autorité
article_manifest.summary: As part of his visits to the structures of the Malian Armed Forces, the Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces (CEMGA), Major General Elisée Jean DAO, accompanied by a delegation, visited the Directorate of the Social Service of the Armed Forces (DSSA) on Thursday, 5 November 2026. Upon his arrival, the Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces and his delegation were welcomed by the Director of the Social Service of the Armed Forces, Colonel-Major Bréhima SAMAKÉ.

article_manifest.title: Bandits Burn 12 Family Members Alive In Zamfara Community
article_manifest.original_title: Bandits Burn 12 Family Members Alive In Zamfara Community
article_manifest.summary: Armed bandits have burnt 12 members of the same family to death and abducted an unspecified number of residents during an attack on Gidan Taba village in Maradun Local Government Area of Zamfara State. The attack occurred on Saturday night in Dosara Birnin Kaya Ward, where the assailants reportedly stormed the community and targeted the family of one Mallam Muhammadu Sani.

article_manifest.title: Bandits kill 12 family members, abduct others in Zamfara
article_manifest.original_title: Bandits kill 12 family members, abduct others in Zamfara
article_manifest.summary: File image of bandits By Idris Salisu, Gusau Armed men suspected to be bandits have killed 12 members of the same family and abducted several residents during an attack on Gidan Taba village in Maradun Local Government Area of Zamfara State. The attack reportedly occurred on Saturday night in Dosara Birnin Kaya Ward, with the assailants setting a room ablaze after the family members reportedly locked themselves inside to avoid being abducted.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Gounzoureye: a community leader kidnapped by Al-Qaeda-linked terrorists, his son reportedly killed
article_manifest.original_title: Gounzoureye : un responsable communautaire enlevé par des terroristes liés à Al-Qaïda, son fils aurait été tué
article_manifest.summary: On April 7, 2024, armed men kidnapped Tami Moudari Touré, a local development figure in Gounzoureye (Gao region). His son was reportedly killed and his daughter allegedly subjected to physical and sexual violence. He remains unaccounted for.

article_manifest.title: Guinea: 1,263 people arrested in the fight against illegal gold panning in Siguiri
article_manifest.original_title: Guinée : 1 263 personnes interpellées dans la lutte contre l’orpaillage illégal à Siguiri
article_manifest.summary: Guinea: 1,263 people arrested in the fight against illegal gold mining in Siguiri The operations initiated by the Guinean authorities against the uncontrolled exploitation of gold in the Siguiri region are taking on a new dimension, with the arrest of 1,263 people of seven nationalities, while the campaign to secure the gold zones is causing mass departures of foreign workers and raising concerns humanitarian and diplomatic assistance in the sub-region.

article_manifest.title: Guinea's refouled crisis: 160,000 people registered, Mali and Burkina Faso are accelerating the...
article_manifest.original_title: Crise des refoulés de Guinée : 160 000 personnes recensées, le Mali et le Burkina Faso accélèrent le...
article_manifest.summary: Refouled Guinea crisis: 160,000 people registered, Mali and Burkina Faso accelerate repatriation Faced with the massive influx of migrants returned from Guinea's gold mining areas, the Malian Government is moving up a gear. The Prime Minister, Head of Government chaired this Saturday, November 7, 2026, an extraordinary meeting of the Interministerial Committee for Crisis and Disaster Management (CECOGEC) At the heart of the discussions at the CECOGEC meeting was the humanitarian situation of thousands of Africans of six nationalities expelled from Guinea and currently in transit to Mali.

article_manifest.title: Refouled from Guinea: Mali mobilizes 74 trucks and 21 buses for the repatriation of 15,000 gold miners
article_manifest.original_title: Refoulés de Guinée : le Mali mobilise 74 camions et 21 bus pour le rapatriement de 15 000 orpailleurs
article_manifest.summary: The Prime Minister, Head of Government, chaired, this Saturday, November 7, 2026, an extraordinary meeting of the Interministerial Committee for Crisis and Disaster Management (CECOGEC), devoted to the humanitarian situation of nationals of six nationalities refouled from the gold mining areas in Guinea This meeting made it possible to take stock on evacuation operations, people still present at reception sites and those already sent to Burkina Faso.

article_manifest.title: Anti-peeling operations in Guinea: 160,000 people returned to Mali
article_manifest.original_title: Opérations anti-orpaillage en Guinée: 160.000 personnes refoulées vers le Mali
article_manifest.summary: Mali has been facing an unprecedented influx of people from the Guinean border region of Siguiri for several days, following Conakry's decision to ban illegal artisanal gold mining in several areas of the northeast and to deploy defence and security forces to enforce this measure "As of November 7, 2026, the balance sheet shows about 100,000 people in the Bamako District and nearly 60,000" in the border locality of Kourémalé, announced the Crisis Coordination and Management Center (CECOGEC).

article_manifest.title: France: Claudy Siar denounces the racism behind the expression "immigrant background"
article_manifest.original_title: France : Claudy Siar dénonce le racisme derrière l'expression « issus de l'immigration »
article_manifest.summary: In a video published on 7 November on social networks, Claudy Siar, mission manager to Beninese President Romuald Wadagni, speaks in her personal capacity. For him, the expression "from immigration" is "probably the most racist of the moment", because it allows to say of a black or Arab French what one would never say of a white . He says he is sometimes frustrated not to be "in this furnace", and recalls his fight for more than thirty years for human dignity, regardless of skin color, religion or social background.

article_manifest.title: Tinubu condoles with Niger junta leader over father’s death
article_manifest.original_title: Tinubu condoles with Niger junta leader over father’s death
article_manifest.summary: President Bola Tinubu has expressed condolences to Niger Republic’s military leader, Abdourahamane Tiani, over the death of his father, Elhadji Hassane. Mr Hassane died on Thursday, 5 November, at the age of 110. In a condolence message issued by presidential spokesperson, Bayo Onanuga, Mr Tinubu said the Nigerian government and people stood in solidarity with Niger during the period of mourning.

article_manifest.title: Guinea/ Fight against illegal gold mining: 1,263 people arrested, including Burkinabe
article_manifest.original_title: Guinée/ Lutte contre l’orpaillage illégal : 1 263 personnes interpellées, dont des Burkinabè
article_manifest.summary: Guinea/ Fight against illegal gold mining: 1,263 people arrested, including Burkinabè The Guinean authorities announce the arrest of 1,263 people of different nationalities, including Burkinabè, in the context of operations against the uncontrolled exploitation of gold in the administrative region of Siguiri . In a joint communiqué dated 7 November 2026, the Ministries of National Defence and Security and Emergency Preparedness indicate that the arrested persons were taken to Conakry for the purposes of the judicial proceedings.

article_manifest.title: Defence: presentation to the flag of the 2025 contingent of the Nigerien Armed Forces formed at the Groupement d 'instruction de ...
article_manifest.original_title: Défense : présentation au drapeau du contingent 2025 des Forces armées nigériennes formé au Groupement d’instruction de ...
article_manifest.summary: The Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces, Brigadier General Mamane Sani Kiaou, chaired, Monday, November 2, 2026, the solemn ceremony of presentation to the flag of the 2025 contingent of new recruits of the Nigerien Armed Forces (FAN), trained at the Tondibiah Training Group, near Niamey After several months of intensive training, these new soldiers from all regions and all social strata of the country have acquired the physical, technical and tactical skills necessary to accomplish their sovereign missions in the service of the nation Now ready to defend the homeland, they officially integrate the large FAN…
